text: Ko an yo Annabiijo ! Men daginanii ma suddiiɓe maa ɓe jonnu-ɗaa teŋe ɓen, e ɓen horɓe ɓe jeyu-ɗaa, ɓe Alla yeɗu-maa e dahaaɓe ɓen. Men daginanii ma kadi resugol jiwɓe bappa maa ɓen, e jiwɓe gorgilaaɓe maa ɓen, e jiwɓe kaawu maa ɓen, e jiwɓe neeniraaɓe maa; ɓen feriduɓe e maaɗa Makka haa Madiina. Men daginanan maa kadi resugol suddiiɗo gomɗinɗo, yeɗuɗo ma hoore-mun, ko aldaa e teŋe, si tawii hiɗa yiɗi resude mo. Resugol on yeɗuɗo hoore-mun non, ko heeranii ɗum Annabiijo on (yo o his), dagantaako goɗɗo goo e mofte ɗen. Gomɗii Meɗen anndi ko Men waɗɗini e gomɗimɓe ɓen kon, fii suddiiɓe maɓɓe ɓen; woni dagantaako ɓe resugol ɓuri rewɓe nayo, Meɗen anndi kadi ko Men sar'inani ɓe kon e horɓe maɓɓe ɓen; woni hino daganoo ɓe dakmitorgol ɓen, no ɓe haajiri, yeru ko ɓe yiɗi e maɓɓe. Men daginanii ma ko jantaa koo, e ko Men daginanaali woɗɓe goo, fii wata ɓiɗteende wonu e maaɗa. Alla siforii haforanoowo kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Hinnotooɗo ɓe.
